metadata.description: Product Marketing Skills for B2B SaaS PMMs — positioning, GTM strategy, competitive intelligence, execution frameworks, and workflow orchestration

plugins.name: pmm-go-to-market
plugins.description: Go-to-market strategy, tier assignment, and workflow orchestration for product launches, positioning refresh, competitive programs, and quarterly PMM cycles

plugins.name: pmm-positioning
plugins.description: Build positioning and messaging that actually lands. Define your ideal customer, map the competitive landscape, and keep your team's story consistent everywhere it's told.

plugins.name: pmm-execution
plugins.description: Day-to-day PMM execution: PRDs, OKRs, pre-mortems, retros, stakeholder maps, interviews, experiments, and prioritization

plugins.name: pmm-growth
plugins.description: Growth ideation and measurement: a North Star Metric and capped scorecard to aim at, brain-grounded campaign ideas, fast, trace-checked value-prop variants of an already-set positioning, and customer stories with every stat and quote checked

plugins.name: pmm-intelligence
plugins.description: A weekly read on what changed around your product: at most five opportunities from signals you name, each tied to a brain field and a quarterly priority

plugins.name: pmm-competitive-intelligence
plugins.description: A roster of your five key competitors kept fresh, plus a one-page battlecard for a live deal, tailored to role, GTM motion, buyer persona and deal stage, built from your brain and alternatives map

plugins.name: pmm-toolkit
plugins.description: PMM utilities: writing assistant (internal messages plus marketing content), resume review, privacy policy generator, GACCS briefs

plugins.name: pmm-meta
plugins.description: Meta skills for skill quality, session learning, and output verification: meta-review, meta-learn, meta-synthesis, meta-verify

plugins.name: product-marketing-context
plugins.description: The PMM brain — builds and maintains /foundation/brain.md, the GTM context file every other plugin in this stack reads before producing output. Install this alongside pmm-positioning; it's the shared foundation the other skills require.
